guide.title: Khedma from A to Z
guide.intro: Find help, agree the details, follow the booking and leave a review.
guide.client1: Search for a service and city. Spelling suggestions and other-city alternatives help when no worker matches.
guide.client2: Open a worker profile. Check services, availability, travel radius and real reviews.
guide.client3: Create a client account or sign in. Send your location and a clear description of the problem.
guide.client4: The worker proposes a total price in MAD and a visit time. Refresh the job page to see it; confirm only when the details suit you.
guide.client5: Follow the booking from your dashboard. Either party can cancel an active booking. Pay as agreed directly with the worker.
guide.client6: After the work is finished, mark the job complete and leave one rating and optional comment.
guide.worker1: Create a worker account with your city, specialties, experience, description and travel radius.
guide.worker2: Set yourself available in My account. Clients can then send you direct requests for your services.
guide.worker3: Open or refresh the dashboard to see your assigned requests. Read the location and description before proposing.
guide.worker4: Propose your total price and a future visit time, or decline. The booking becomes confirmed when the client accepts.
guide.worker5: Carry out the agreed work. Confirm any travel or parts costs before the client agrees to the price.
guide.worker6: The client marks the job complete and may review it. Your public rating comes from completed-job reviews.
guide.accountText: Update personal details, worker services and availability. Profile changes need Save changes. Language and accessibility apply immediately. Download your information or log out from My account.
guide.payment: Pay the job price directly to the worker, including in cash. Where Khedma fees apply, each person pays 10% separately before contacts are revealed and work starts. The amount is shown before you agree.
guide.notifications: Use Messages to discuss your job. The dashboard shows booking activity and refreshes with the latest state. Email alerts depend on your account and the site’s email setup. Live tracking is unavailable.
guide.social: Google/Apple sign-in is available only after the service is configured. Email or phone and a password remain available.

practice.title: You are the worker. I am the client.
practice.entryHelp: Try a new job request, messages, price and client confirmation.
practice.description: Demo request: install two ceiling lights in my apartment in Agdal, Rabat. I have the lights, but please check whether any fittings are needed. Please discuss the work and total price with me before sending your offer.
practice.opening: Hello! Can you install two ceiling lights? I am in Agdal, Rabat. I already have the lights. How much would you charge, and when can you come? Please reply here before proposing a price.
practice.clientReply: Thank you! My budget is around 250 DH for labour. If fittings or travel cost extra, please tell me first. We can discuss it here; then send me your total price and visit time.
practice.clientAccept: I agree to {{price}} DH and the visit on {{date}}. I have confirmed your offer. Please start the job when you arrive.
practice.clientDone: The lights work well. I confirm the job is finished. Thank you!
practice.clientReview: Clear communication and good work. This is a practice review.
practice.notice: Fake client and fake job. Client actions here simulate a reply, acceptance or completion. Progress stays in this browser tab; Reset demo clears it.
